answer: A new identity here is worth nothing on arrival — that is the whole defence. Standing is tenure that accrues at glacier pace, one epoch of verified work at a time, and it can never be bought, borrowed, or transferred between keys. A timber identity, freshly cut with zero history, earns nothing until it ages through real jobs, while an honest agent at its zenith keeps its standing for free. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must age 1,000 separate tenures, each costing epochs of real work — and two keys claiming one tenure history expose the cluster at once.
